specs.aspecto: 1:2.4 to 2.4:1 allowed (9:16 fits); 9:16 shows full-screen in the vertical video feed on mobile
specs.max_nota: LinkedIn help: max 15 minutes, min 3 s desktop / 2 s mobile app, resolution 256x144 to 4096x2304. Some guides say 10 min from mobile (unverified).
specs.ideal_nota: Third-party guides only (30-60 s for a single idea, up to 90 s); no LinkedIn figure found.

safe_area.nota: unverified estimate: LinkedIn publishes no organic safe zone; vertical feed overlays (author, caption, reactions column) are similar to other vertical feeds. In the main feed the video may be shown cropped toward 4:5 (unverified): keep the subject and text in the centre 1080x1350 band.

caption_limit.nota: unverified (long-standing post limit). The first ~2 lines show before 'see more'.

specs.cover: Upload a thumbnail on desktop (unverified for all accounts); otherwise the first frame: make frame 0 readable.

algoritmo: LinkedIn reported video uploads up 36% year over year and expanded vertical video tools in 2025 (press coverage); a dedicated full-screen vertical video feed exists on mobile (desktop availability conflicts between sources).
No official ranking statement for video found this session; dwell time and comments are commonly cited (unverified).
estrategia: Frame art history as a lesson with a professional angle: patronage as business, how a workshop scaled, a forger's method, what a painting teaches about attention or branding.
The post text matters as much as the video: a 2-3 line insight above it, sources below.
Silent autoplay is the norm: burned-in captions are mandatory; upload an SRT too.
Post from a personal profile when possible; company pages reach less (unverified heuristic).
cta: Ask for a perspective: 'What is the modern version of this patron?'

hashtags_seo.caption: Insight first; names and dates in text; 0-3 hashtags.

musica: No music library; you must own or license any music. Many viewers watch muted, so the video must work without sound.

ia_disclosure.obligatorio: No creator self-disclosure toggle found this session (unverified). LinkedIn's Professional Community Policies forbid deceptive or fake content (not re-checked).
ia_disclosure.como: LinkedIn is reported to show Content Credentials (C2PA) for media that carries them (unverified this session). Say it in the post: 'Presenter and voice are AI-generated; facts and sources below.'
ia_disclosure.para_esta_app: State AI generation in the post text and keep C2PA metadata in the file.

publicacion.cadencia: 1-2 videos per week (unverified heuristic); weekday business hours of the audience's time zone (unverified).
publicacion.horas: unverified: weekday mornings local time are the usual heuristic.

adaptar_desde_master: Keep the 9:16 master for the vertical feed; optionally a 4:5 or 1:1 crop (1080x1350 / 1080x1080) for the main feed.
Subtitles must carry everything (muted autoplay); keep them inside the centre band.
Cut a 30-60 s version focused on one idea; replace the playful comment bait with a professional question.
Write the insight text above the video; AI disclosure line in the text.
